broker.name: Defcofx
broker.tagline: A Saint Lucia-registered forex and CFD broker on MetaTrader 5. It does not publish a financial-conduct licence from a regulator such as the FCA or ASIC.
broker.about: Defcofx says it was founded in 2022, opened more widely in 2024, and is based at Rodney Bay in Saint Lucia. It offers forex and CFDs, including gold, oil, indices and stocks, plus crypto, on MetaTrader 5. Silver accounts list a $50 minimum and leverage up to 1:2000. Gold accounts list $1,000 and leverage up to 1:500. The broker advertises zero commission, swap-free accounts and spreads from 0.3 pips. It also advertises withdrawals within four business hours. The only registration number on its site is 2024-00205 in Saint Lucia. That is a company registration, not a licence from a financial conduct regulator.
broker.regulators_note: Defcofx publishes registration number 2024-00205 and the address Ground Floor, The Sotheby Building, Rodney Village, Rodney Bay, Gros-Islet, Saint Lucia. The owner brief calls this a Saint Lucia licence. The number matches the company's own FAQ. It is a company registration. It is not a financial-services licence from a conduct regulator, and it does not provide the same protections as an FCA, ASIC or CySEC firm. The company name on the registration was not printed next to the number on the pages checked.

plans.name: Silver
plans.billing_note: Leverage up to 1:2000. Commission advertised at $0. Account overview lists spreads from 0.5 pips. The owner brief and the homepage say from 0.3.

plans.name: Gold
plans.billing_note: Leverage up to 1:500. Commission advertised at $0. Same spread conflict as Silver: 0.5 on the account table, 0.3 on the owner brief.

rows.label: Advertised spread
rows.note: Owner brief and Defcofx homepage. The accounts overview table says spreads from 0.5 pips for both Silver and Gold. The FAQ also says spreads can be as low as 0.2 pips, and the homepage also says from 0.0. Commission is advertised at $0.

broker.costs_note: Use 0.3 pips as the headline because that is the owner's figure and it also appears on the homepage. The account table's 0.5 pip figure is kept in the note because it disagrees. Live spreads move either way.

leverage.note: Defcofx says the maximum applies to forex currencies and depends on the account type.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. 1:2000 is a very high setting and is only on the Silver account for forex. There is no conduct regulator behind this account of the kind an FCA or ASIC firm has.

_notes.source: Owner brief (primary for the spread headline, deposit split, leverage, platform, HQ, products and the bonus). FAQ, about page, homepage and accounts overview on defcofx.com. Registration 2024-00205 matches the FAQ. Founded 2022 and 'went global in 2024' are from the FAQ. Trustpilot defcofx.com showed TrustScore 4.5 from 71 reviews on the fetched profile. Logo downloaded from the broker's own site.
_notes.disagreements: The owner lists 'Saint Lucia licence 2024-00205'. The number is kept and labelled as a company registration, not as an FCA-style conduct licence. That is a precision note, not a change to the number. Spread: owner and homepage say from 0.3 pips. Accounts overview says 0.5. FAQ says as low as 0.2. Homepage also says from 0.0. Headline follows the owner. The 40% bonus was not on the FAQ or accounts pages opened for this pass. The homepage also says 'futures'. Exchange-traded futures were not confirmed, so the markets list uses CFDs, forex, stocks and crypto rather than the futures category.
